ENGLISH ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Language Activities at home, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language Activities at home.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Language Activities at home.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Language Activities at home.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Language Activities at home.

2. When practising Spelling, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Spelling.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Spelling.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Spelling.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Spelling.

3. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. Only one word repeated
   B. No full stops
   C. Many unrelated topics with no link
   D. One main idea with supporting sentences

4. When practising Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Handwriting.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Handwriting.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Handwriting.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Handwriting.

5. When practising Word Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Word Reading.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Word Reading.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word Reading.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Word Reading.

6. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only a joining word
   B. Only an action
   C. Only a describing word
   D. A person, place, thing, or idea

7. When practising Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Comprehension.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Comprehension.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Comprehension.

8. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. run
   B. quickly
   C. happiness
   D. blue

9. When practising Guided Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Guided Writing.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Guided Writing.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Guided Writing.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Guided Writing.

10. When practising Attentive Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Attentive Listening.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive Listening.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive Listening.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Attentive Listening.

11. When practising Punctuation, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Punctuation.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Punctuation.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Punctuation.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Punctuation.

12. When practising Connected text and fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Connected text and fluency.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Connected text and fluency.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Connected text and fluency.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Connected text and fluency.

13. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. goes
   B. went
   C. going
   D. goed

14. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the Library
   B. Where is the library?
   C. Where is the library
   D. where is the library

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
15. In three clear sentences, explain Language Activities at home and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Handwriting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Spelling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Punctuation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Attentive Listening and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Word Reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
